rationale: The stock gapped up ~4.8% on negative earnings news (missed revenue and EPS), creating a confusing signal — the gap-up contradicts the fundamental miss, suggesting possible short-covering or sector rotation rather than a clean directional setup. Price is sitting in the upper 77% of today's range but showing choppy 1-minute action with no clear momentum (alternating up/down closes, high volume on a down candle), and the wide bid-ask spread of 36 bps adds friction. With today already down $132 and no clear mechanical edge in either direction, the risk/reward does not justify entry.
